# CANDIDATE: VIX_STRATIFIED_LOOKAHEAD_GUARD_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Look-ahead bias may have inflated edge capture in prior backtests; stratifying by VIX regimes will test whether the edge is robust across market conditions or driven by a single volatility regime.

## Mechanism

Run Stage-1 backtest with strict look-ahead guards (filter all indicator/history calculations to bars timestamped <= current bar) and compute edge capture per VIX regime (low: VIX<15, medium: 15≤VIX≤25, high: VIX>25). Also compute wide PnL, win rate, trade count, and concentration (top5_pct). Output an A/B scorecard comparing edge capture vs. wide PnL discrepancy and register the artifact.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** using the same 6 J anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers) and historical SPY/VIX bars from 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (per params). Overfit risk is high due to small anchor sample; VIX stratification further reduces per-regime sample size.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this is Stage-1 only; no OOS/WF performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (BS-synthetic option pricing used; real OPRA fills not yet validated).
5. **Failure modes:** worst day could be a high-VIX regime day where the edge reverses; max drawdown observed in Stage-1 was $4,701.52; blow-up scenario if VIX regime shift causes systematic losses across multiple days.
6. **Concentration:** Stage-1 top5_pct = 999.0 (indicating extreme concentration); post-stratification concentration will be reported in the scorecard.
